scopes.hint: Data scope: Own = records the user owns; Team = own and those of direct reports; Unit = the user's unit only; Unit and below = the user's unit and every unit under it.

principals.unitHint: Every user whose employee is in this unit or a unit under it.

pickers.user: Search a user by name or e-mail

roles.title: Roles and permissions
roles.description: Each system has its own roles. Choose each role's permissions and data scope.
roles.newDescription: A new role in the selected system, without permissions until you set them in the matrix.
roles.matrixCaption: Permission matrix: permissions in rows, roles in columns
roles.noRecordRoles: This system has no record roles.
roles.recordRolesHint: A record role gives its permissions on the one record it was granted on (e.g. Project Manager of one project).

assignments.title: Role assignments
assignments.description: Who holds each role, from when to when. A unit assignment covers everyone in the unit and below.
assignments.newDescription: Choose the role and who holds it.
assignments.endDescription: The assignment ends at the end of yesterday; the holder loses this role's permissions at once.

systemAccess.title: System access
systemAccess.description: Layer 1: who may open the system at all. Roles do nothing without access to their system.
systemAccess.empty: Nobody can open this system yet

transfer.title: Bulk role transfer
transfer.description: Ends the selected assignments and recreates them for the new holder in one logged step.
transfer.pendingHint: Pending approvals and open tasks move too once the approval engine is in place.

review.title: Access review
review.description: Every user, their roles, where each role comes from, and the permissions with their scope. Export to Excel for auditors.

errors.roleLocked: This role is locked: its permissions cannot be removed and it cannot be deactivated.
errors.duplicateRoleCode: A role with this code already exists in this system.
errors.assignmentOverlap: This role is already assigned to them for an overlapping period.
errors.lastAdministrator: The last access administrator cannot be removed.
errors.systemAccessDuplicate: They already have access to this system.
errors.transferSource: Choose users or one unit as the source.
errors.transferTarget: Choose a user or a unit as the target.
errors.nothingToMove: No assignment of these roles is in force at the source.
errors.membersPeopleOnly: Only people can be system administrators.
errors.membersNoRoles: This list has no active role. Check the lists of this system.
errors.membersAlreadyMember: They are already on this list.
errors.memberRolesOverlap: A role can be on one list only.

members.title: Members
members.description: Who administers and who uses this system. Changes apply at once, are recorded in the audit trail and the person concerned is notified.
members.hubDescription: Choose a system to manage its administrators, users and extra roles.
members.hubEmpty: You do not manage the members of any system.
members.notFound: This system has no Members page or is switched off.

hints.users: People, units (with their sub-units) or all employees who use this system (role: {{roles}}).
hints.extra: Holders of this additional role of the system.

members.addDescription: Choose a person, a unit (its sub-units are included) or all employees. Dates are optional.
members.everyoneHint: Every employee with an account gets the access of this list.
members.note: Note (optional, kept in the audit trail)
members.empty: No one is on this list yet.
members.removeDescription: Their access through this list ends now. Nothing is deleted: the change is recorded in the audit trail and the person is notified.

config.title: Lists of this system
config.description: Which role each list stands for. The defaults come with the system; your choice applies to the Members page only.
